*SOPHIA notes: Column 1 is nearly destroyed. Consensus largely follows EMET/LOGOS where text survives, with minor PNEUMA influence in 1:13. The surviving fragments establish Lamech as narrator, his fear about the nature of his son, and references to the Watchers and Nephilim — themes drawn from the Enochic tradition.*
